LESSON: WRITING 11.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: ABBREVIATIONS AND ACRONYMS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.5: Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which words do we normally abbreviate?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. spell words for effective communication
2. write common abbreviations and acronyms in full
3. appreciate the importance of abbreviations and acronyms in writing

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 11.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: ABBREVIATIONS AND ACRONYMS
This lesson teaches Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. spell words for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write common abbreviations and acronyms in full
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of abbreviations and acronyms in writing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms above.
2. Explain Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Abbreviations and Acronyms important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which words do we normally abbreviate?

SECTION: REMEMBER

2. write common abbreviations and acronyms in full
